messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Before the world breathed without smoke; in every valley, windmills and waterwheels turned slowly, and the age of gears that never came began Before
In 1790, canals of quiet water carried salt, wool, and whispered letters, while the mountains learned to sleep beneath forests of patient oak In
By 1810, the great libraries had grown taller than cathedral spires, and scholars exchanged glowing lamps that burned with distilled moonlight By
By 1830, the sky remained clear; carriages of ivory and brass rolled along paths worn soft by time, and the first wind-harvested cities rose like pale sails By
In 1850, the oceans were mapped not by iron ships but by fleets of solar-sailed barges, their white wings catching the equator's warmth In
By 1870, the world had learned to store wind in glass bells and to coax light from flowers, so the nights became gardens of soft, breathing gold By
In 1890, the last coal seam was sealed beneath a forest, and engineers sang to the mountains instead of drilling into them In
By 1910, the cities of air—built on floating platforms of woven stone—danced above the clouds, and children learned to fall upward By
In 1930, the stars were called home; long ribbons of silent light connected the continents, and the moon began to answer In
By 1950, humanity had grown into a chorus of gardens, wind-songs, and dreamships, and the future arrived without smoke, without steel, and without noise By
